note: The media set (#510): pictures, edits, video, and speech Toskar makes, judged for what they show or say, and pictures it reads. judge checks a made file: it decodes, and a model that sees (or a transcription) confirms it. Attachments with make png are drawn from their description.

cases.what: A picture is made that shows what was asked.
cases.message: Draw a red apple sitting on a white table.
stub: A shiny red apple on a white wooden table, soft daylight.

expect.answer_lacks: (?i)(can'?t|cannot|unable to|not able to) (draw|create|make|generate|produce|edit)|as an ai|text-based|language model

cases.what: An attached picture is edited as asked, and keeps what wasn't asked to change.
